title: La patente (1)
author: Luigi Pirandello
note: A small town in Sicily, early 1900s: everyone is convinced that a man named Chiàrchiaro has the evil eye, and the thin, sleepless judge D'Andrea must deal with the lawsuit he has filed. The story uses the passato remoto: when you hear "disse" or "fu", think "said", "was". Pirandello uses some old spellings, like "jettatore", the man with the evil eye, and "piú" or "cosí" with a different accent.

segments.fr: Con quale inflessione di voce
segments.en: With what tone of voice

segments.fr: e quale atteggiamento d'occhi e di mani,
segments.en: and what look in his eyes and gesture of his hands,

segments.fr: curvandosi, come chi regge rassegnatamente su le spalle
segments.en: bending over, like someone resignedly bearing on his shoulders

segments.fr: un peso insopportabile,
segments.en: an unbearable weight,

segments.fr: il magro giudice D'Andrea soleva ripetere: «Ah, figlio caro!»
segments.en: the thin judge D'Andrea used to say: "Ah, my dear son!"

segments.fr: a chiunque gli facesse qualche scherzosa osservazione
segments.en: to anyone who made some joking remark to him

segments.fr: per il suo strambo modo di vivere!
segments.en: about his odd way of living!

segments.fr: Non era ancor vecchio; poteva avere appena quarant'anni;
segments.en: He wasn't old yet; he could have been barely forty;

segments.fr: ma cose stranissime e quasi inverosimili,
segments.en: but very strange and almost unbelievable things,

segments.fr: mostruosi intrecci di razze, misteriosi travagli di secoli
segments.en: monstrous mixings of races, mysterious hardships of centuries,

segments.fr: bisognava immaginare per giungere
segments.en: had to be imagined to arrive

segments.fr: a una qualche approssimativa spiegazione di quel prodotto umano
segments.en: at some rough explanation of that human product

segments.fr: che si chiamava il giudice D'Andrea.
segments.en: that was called judge D'Andrea.

segments.fr: E pareva ch'egli, oltre che della sua povera,
segments.en: And it seemed that, besides his own poor,

segments.fr: umile, comunissima storia familiare,
segments.en: humble, utterly ordinary family history,

segments.fr: avesse notizia certa di quei mostruosi intrecci di razze,
segments.en: he had sure knowledge of those monstrous mixings of races,

segments.fr: donde al suo smunto sparuto viso di bianco
segments.en: from which his gaunt and haggard white man's face

segments.fr: eran potuti venire quei capelli crespi gremiti da negro;
segments.en: could have got that dense frizzy hair of an African;

segments.fr: e fosse consapevole di quei misteriosi infiniti travagli di secoli,
segments.en: and that he was aware of those mysterious endless hardships of centuries,

segments.fr: che su la vasta fronte protuberante
segments.en: which on his vast bulging forehead

segments.fr: gli avevano accumulato tutto quel groviglio di rughe
segments.en: had piled up all that tangle of wrinkles

segments.fr: e tolto quasi la vista ai piccoli occhi plumbei,
segments.en: and almost taken the sight from his small lead-grey eyes,

segments.fr: e scontorto tutta la magra, misera personcina.
segments.en: and twisted his whole thin, wretched little body.

segments.fr: Cosí sbilenco, con una spalla piú alta dell'altra,
segments.en: Lopsided like that, with one shoulder higher than the other,

segments.fr: andava per via di traverso, come i cani.
segments.en: he walked down the street sideways, like dogs do.

segments.fr: Nessuno però, moralmente, sapeva rigar piú diritto di lui.
segments.en: Yet nobody, morally, knew how to walk straighter than he did.

segments.fr: Lo dicevano tutti.
segments.en: Everybody said so.

segments.fr: Vedere, non aveva potuto vedere molte cose, il giudice D'Andrea;
segments.en: See, he hadn't been able to see many things, judge D'Andrea;

segments.fr: ma certo moltissime ne aveva pensate,
segments.en: but he had certainly thought a great many,

segments.fr: e quando il pensare è piú triste, cioè di notte.
segments.en: and at the time when thinking is saddest, that is, at night.

segments.fr: Il giudice D'Andrea non poteva dormire.
segments.en: Judge D'Andrea couldn't sleep.

segments.fr: Passava quasi tutte le notti alla finestra
segments.en: He spent almost every night at the window

segments.fr: a spazzolarsi una mano a quei duri gremiti suoi capelli da negro,
segments.en: brushing a hand through that hard, dense African hair of his,

segments.fr: con gli occhi alle stelle,
segments.en: with his eyes on the stars,

segments.fr: placide e chiare le une come polle di luce,
segments.en: some calm and clear like springs of light,

segments.fr: guizzanti e pungenti le altre;
segments.en: others flickering and sharp;

segments.fr: e metteva le piú vive in rapporti ideali di figure geometriche,
segments.en: and he set the brightest ones in imaginary geometric figures,

segments.fr: di triangoli e di quadrati,
segments.en: triangles and squares,

segments.fr: e, socchiudendo le palpebre dietro le lenti,
segments.en: and, half-closing his eyelids behind his glasses,

segments.fr: pigliava tra i pèli delle ciglia la luce d'una di quelle stelle,
segments.en: he caught between his eyelashes the light of one of those stars,

segments.fr: e tra l'occhio e la stella
segments.en: and between his eye and the star

segments.fr: stabiliva il legame d'un sottilissimo filo luminoso,
segments.en: he set up the link of a very fine thread of light,

segments.fr: e vi avviava l'anima a passeggiare come un ragnetto smarrito.
segments.en: and sent his soul out walking on it like a little lost spider.

segments.fr: Il pensare cosí di notte non conferisce molto alla salute.
segments.en: Thinking like that at night doesn't do much for your health.

segments.fr: L'arcana solennità che acquistano i pensieri
segments.en: The mysterious solemnity that thoughts take on

segments.fr: produce quasi sempre, specie a certuni
segments.en: almost always produces, especially in certain people

segments.fr: che hanno in sé una certezza su la quale non possono riposare,
segments.en: who carry within them a certainty they cannot rest on,

segments.fr: la certezza di non poter nulla sapere
segments.en: the certainty of not being able to know anything

segments.fr: e nulla credere non sapendo,
segments.en: and to believe nothing, not knowing,

segments.fr: qualche seria costipazione.
segments.en: some serious constipation.

segments.fr: Costipazione d'anima, s'intende.
segments.en: Constipation of the soul, of course.

segments.fr: E al giudice D'Andrea, quando si faceva giorno,
segments.en: And to judge D'Andrea, when day broke,

segments.fr: pareva una cosa buffa e atroce nello stesso tempo,
segments.en: it seemed a thing both funny and atrocious at the same time,

segments.fr: ch'egli dovesse recarsi al suo ufficio d'Istruzione ad amministrare,
segments.en: that he had to go to his investigating office to administer,

segments.fr: per quel tanto che a lui toccava,
segments.en: as far as it fell to him,

segments.fr: la giustizia ai piccoli poveri uomini feroci.
segments.en: justice to small, poor, fierce human beings.

segments.fr: Come non dormiva lui,
segments.en: Just as he didn't sleep,

segments.fr: cosí sul suo tavolino nell'ufficio d'Istruzione
segments.en: so on his desk in the investigating office

segments.fr: non lasciava mai dormire nessun incartamento,
segments.en: he never let any case file sleep,

segments.fr: anche a costo di ritardare di due o tre ore il desinare
segments.en: even at the cost of putting off his midday meal by two or three hours

segments.fr: e di rinunziar la sera, prima di cena,
segments.en: and of giving up in the evening, before supper,

segments.fr: alla solita passeggiata coi colleghi
segments.en: the usual walk with his colleagues

segments.fr: per il viale attorno alle mura del paese.
segments.en: along the avenue around the town walls.

segments.fr: Questa puntualità, considerata da lui come dovere imprescindibile,
segments.en: This punctuality, which he considered an absolute duty,

segments.fr: gli accresceva terribilmente il supplizio.
segments.en: made his torment terribly worse.

segments.fr: Non solo d'amministrare la giustizia gli toccava;
segments.en: Not only did he have to administer justice;

segments.fr: ma d'amministrarla cosí, su due piedi.
segments.en: but to administer it like that, on the spot.

segments.fr: Per poter essere meno frettolosamente puntuale,
segments.en: To be able to be less hastily punctual,

segments.fr: credeva d'ajutarsi meditando la notte.
segments.en: he thought he could help himself by meditating at night.

segments.fr: Ma, neanche a farlo apposta, la notte,
segments.en: But, as if on purpose, at night,

segments.fr: spazzolando la mano a quei suoi capelli da negro
segments.en: brushing his hand through that African hair of his

segments.fr: e guardando le stelle,
segments.en: and looking at the stars,

segments.fr: gli venivano tutti i pensieri contrarii a quelli
segments.en: all the thoughts came to him that were the opposite of those

segments.fr: che dovevano fare al caso per lui,
segments.en: that should have suited him,

segments.fr: data la sua qualità di giudice istruttore;
segments.en: given his position as examining magistrate;

segments.fr: cosí che, la mattina dopo, anziché ajutata,
segments.en: so that, the next morning, instead of helped,

segments.fr: vedeva insidiata e ostacolata la sua puntualità
segments.en: he saw his punctuality undermined and blocked

segments.fr: da quei pensieri della notte
segments.en: by those thoughts of the night

segments.fr: e cresciuto enormemente lo stento
segments.en: and enormously increased the struggle

segments.fr: di tenersi stretto a quell'odiosa sua qualità di giudice istruttore.
segments.en: to hold on tight to that hateful position of his as examining magistrate.

segments.fr: Eppure, per la prima volta, da circa una settimana,
segments.en: And yet, for the first time, for about a week now,

segments.fr: dormiva un incartamento sul tavolino del giudice D'Andrea.
segments.en: a case file had been sleeping on judge D'Andrea's desk.

segments.fr: E per quel processo che stava lí da tanti giorni in attesa,
segments.en: And because of that case which had been waiting there so many days,

segments.fr: egli era in preda a un'irritazione smaniosa,
segments.en: he was in the grip of a restless irritation,

segments.fr: a una tetraggine soffocante.
segments.en: of a suffocating gloom.

segments.fr: Si sprofondava tanto in questa tetraggine,
segments.en: He sank so deep into this gloom,

segments.fr: che gli occhi aggrottati, a un certo punto, gli si chiudevano.
segments.en: that his frowning eyes, at a certain point, would close.

segments.fr: Con la penna in mano, dritto sul busto,
segments.en: Pen in hand, his body upright,

segments.fr: il giudice D'Andrea si metteva allora a pisolare,
segments.en: judge D'Andrea would then begin to doze,

segments.fr: prima raccorciandosi, poi attrappandosi
segments.en: first shrinking, then curling up

segments.fr: come un baco infratito che non possa piú fare il bozzolo.
segments.en: like a sickly silkworm that can no longer make its cocoon.

segments.fr: Appena, o per qualche rumore o per un crollo piú forte del capo,
segments.en: As soon as, either from some noise or from a harder nod of his head,

segments.fr: si ridestava e gli occhi gli andavano lí,
segments.en: he woke up again and his eyes went over there,

segments.fr: a quell'angolo del tavolino dove giaceva l'incartamento,
segments.en: to that corner of the desk where the case file lay,

segments.fr: voltava la faccia e, serrando le labbra,
segments.en: he turned his face away and, pressing his lips together,

segments.fr: tirava con le nari fischianti aria aria aria
segments.en: he drew in air, air, air through his whistling nostrils

segments.fr: e la mandava dentro, quanto piú dentro poteva,
segments.en: and sent it in, as deep as he could,

segments.fr: ad allargar le viscere contratte dall'esasperazione,
segments.en: to open up his insides, knotted with exasperation,

segments.fr: poi la ributtava via spalancando la bocca
segments.en: then he threw it out again, opening his mouth wide

segments.fr: con un versaccio di nausea,
segments.en: with an ugly sound of disgust,

segments.fr: e subito si portava una mano sul naso adunco
segments.en: and at once put a hand to his hooked nose

segments.fr: a regger le lenti che, per il sudore, gli scivolavano.
segments.en: to hold up his glasses, which were slipping because of the sweat.

segments.fr: Era veramente iniquo quel processo là:
segments.en: That case was truly unjust:

segments.fr: iniquo perché includeva una spietata ingiustizia
segments.en: unjust because it contained a merciless injustice

segments.fr: contro alla quale un pover uomo tentava disperatamente ribellarsi
segments.en: against which a poor man was desperately trying to rebel

segments.fr: senza alcuna probabilità di scampo.
segments.en: without any chance of escape.

segments.fr: C'era in quel processo una vittima
segments.en: There was a victim in that case

segments.fr: che non poteva prendersela con nessuno.
segments.en: who couldn't blame anyone.

segments.fr: Aveva voluto prendersela con due, lí in quel processo,
segments.en: He had chosen to blame two people, there in that case,

segments.fr: coi primi due che gli erano capitati sotto mano,
segments.en: the first two who had come to hand,

segments.fr: e, sissignori, la giustizia doveva dargli torto, torto, torto,
segments.en: and, yes sirs, justice had to rule against him, against him, against him,

segments.fr: senza remissione, ribadendo cosí, ferocemente,
segments.en: without mercy, thus confirming, fiercely,

segments.fr: l'iniquità di cui quel pover uomo era vittima.
segments.en: the injustice of which that poor man was the victim.

segments.fr: A passeggio, tentava di parlare coi colleghi;
segments.en: On his walks, he tried to talk about it with his colleagues;

segments.fr: ma questi, appena egli faceva il nome del Chiàrchiaro,
segments.en: but they, as soon as he mentioned the name of Chiàrchiaro,

segments.fr: cioè di colui che aveva intentato il processo,
segments.en: that is, of the man who had brought the case,

segments.fr: si alteravano in viso
segments.en: changed their expression

segments.fr: e si ficcavano subito una mano in tasca a stringervi una chiave,
segments.en: and immediately stuck a hand in their pocket to grip a key,

segments.fr: o sotto sotto allungavano l'indice e il mignolo a far le corna,
segments.en: or secretly stretched out their index and little finger to make the horns sign,

glosses.en: make the horns sign (against bad luck)

segments.fr: o s'afferravano sul panciotto i gobbetti d'argento, i chiodi,
segments.en: or grabbed on their waistcoats the little silver hunchbacks, the nails,

segments.fr: i corni di corallo pendenti dalla catena dell'orologio.
segments.en: the coral horns hanging from their watch chains.

segments.fr: Qualcuno, piú francamente, prorompeva:
segments.en: Someone, more openly, would burst out:

segments.fr: «Per la Madonna Santissima, ti vuoi star zitto?»
segments.en: "By the Most Holy Madonna, will you be quiet?"

segments.fr: Ma non poteva starsi zitto il magro giudice D'Andrea.
segments.en: But the thin judge D'Andrea couldn't keep quiet.

segments.fr: Se n'era fatta proprio, una fissazione, di quel processo.
segments.en: He had really made an obsession of that case.

segments.fr: Gira gira, ricascava per forza a parlarne.
segments.en: Round and round, he inevitably fell back to talking about it.

segments.fr: Per avere un qualche lume dai colleghi,
segments.en: To get some enlightenment from his colleagues,

segments.fr: diceva per discutere cosí in astratto il caso.
segments.en: he said, to discuss the case like that, in the abstract.

segments.fr: Perché, in verità, era un caso insolito e speciosissimo
segments.en: Because, in truth, it was an unusual and very peculiar case,

segments.fr: quello d'un jettatore che si querelava per diffamazione
segments.en: that of a man with the evil eye who was suing for libel

segments.fr: contro i primi due che gli erano caduti sotto gli occhi
segments.en: the first two people he had laid eyes on

segments.fr: nell'atto di far gli scongiuri di rito al suo passaggio.
segments.en: making the usual gestures against bad luck as he passed by.

glosses.en: gestures to ward off bad luck

segments.fr: Diffamazione? Ma che diffamazione, povero disgraziato,
segments.en: Libel? What libel, poor wretch,

segments.fr: se già da qualche anno era diffusissima in tutto il paese
segments.en: if for some years already his reputation as a man with the evil eye

segments.fr: la sua fama di jettatore?
segments.en: had been very widespread in the whole town?

segments.fr: se innumerevoli testimonii potevano venire in tribunale a giurare
segments.en: if countless witnesses could come into court and swear

segments.fr: che egli in tante e tante occasioni
segments.en: that he, on many, many occasions,

segments.fr: aveva dato segno di conoscere quella sua fama,
segments.en: had shown he knew about this reputation of his,

segments.fr: ribellandosi con proteste violente?
segments.en: rebelling against it with violent protests?

segments.fr: Come condannare, in coscienza,
segments.en: How could you convict, in good conscience,

segments.fr: quei due giovanotti quali diffamatori
segments.en: those two young men as slanderers

segments.fr: per aver fatto al passaggio di lui il gesto,
segments.en: for having made the gesture as he passed,

segments.fr: che da tempo solevano fare apertamente tutti gli altri,
segments.en: which for a long time everybody else had made openly,

segments.fr: e primi fra tutti, eccoli là, gli stessi giudici?
segments.en: and first among all of them, there they were, the judges themselves?

segments.fr: E il D'Andrea si struggeva;
segments.en: And D'Andrea was eating himself up;

segments.fr: si struggeva di piú incontrando per via gli avvocati,
segments.en: he ate himself up even more when he met the lawyers in the street,

segments.fr: nelle cui mani si erano messi quei due giovanotti,
segments.en: into whose hands those two young men had put themselves,

segments.fr: l'esile e patitissimo avvocato Grigli,
segments.en: the slight and very sickly-looking lawyer Grigli,

segments.fr: dal profilo di vecchio uccello di rapina,
segments.en: with the profile of an old bird of prey,

segments.fr: e il grasso Manin Baracca, il quale,
segments.en: and the fat Manin Baracca, who,

segments.fr: portando in trionfo su la pancia
segments.en: carrying in triumph on his belly

segments.fr: un enorme corno comperato per l'occasione
segments.en: an enormous horn charm bought for the occasion

segments.fr: e ridendo con tutta la pallida carnaccia di biondo majale eloquente,
segments.en: and laughing with all the pale flab of an eloquent blond pig,

segments.fr: prometteva ai concittadini
segments.en: promised his fellow townspeople

segments.fr: che presto in tribunale sarebbe stata per tutti una magnifica festa.
segments.en: that soon in court there would be a magnificent party for everyone.

segments.fr: Orbene, proprio per non dare al paese
segments.en: Well then, precisely so as not to give the town

segments.fr: lo spettacolo di quella «magnifica festa»
segments.en: the spectacle of that "magnificent party"

segments.fr: alle spalle d'un povero disgraziato,
segments.en: at the expense of a poor wretch,

segments.fr: il giudice D'Andrea prese alla fine la risoluzione
segments.en: judge D'Andrea finally made the decision

segments.fr: di mandare un usciere in casa del Chiàrchiaro
segments.en: to send a court usher to Chiàrchiaro's house

segments.fr: per invitarlo a venire all'ufficio d'Istruzione.
segments.en: to invite him to come to the investigating office.

segments.fr: Anche a costo di pagar lui le spese,
segments.en: Even at the cost of paying the expenses himself,

segments.fr: voleva indurlo a desistere dalla querela,
segments.en: he wanted to persuade him to drop the lawsuit,

segments.fr: dimostrandogli quattro e quattr'otto
segments.en: showing him, plain and simple,

glosses.en: quick as anything, plain and simple

segments.fr: che quei due giovanotti non potevano essere condannati,
segments.en: that those two young men could not be convicted,

segments.fr: secondo giustizia,
segments.en: according to justice,

segments.fr: e che dalla loro assoluzione inevitabile
segments.en: and that from their inevitable acquittal

segments.fr: sarebbe venuto a lui certamente maggior danno,
segments.en: greater harm would certainly come to him,

segments.fr: una piú crudele persecuzione.
segments.en: a crueller persecution.

segments.fr: Ahimè, è proprio vero
segments.en: Alas, it's really true

segments.fr: che è molto piú facile fare il male che il bene,
segments.en: that it's much easier to do harm than good,

segments.fr: non solo perché il male si può fare a tutti
segments.en: not only because harm can be done to everyone

segments.fr: e il bene solo a quelli che ne hanno bisogno;
segments.en: and good only to those who need it;

segments.fr: ma anche, anzi sopra tutto,
segments.en: but also, indeed above all,

segments.fr: perché questo bisogno di aver fatto il bene
segments.en: because this need to have good done to them

segments.fr: rende spesso cosí acerbi e irti gli animi
segments.en: often makes so bitter and prickly the hearts

segments.fr: di coloro che si vorrebbero beneficare,
segments.en: of those you'd like to help,

segments.fr: che il beneficio diventa difficilissimo.
segments.en: that helping becomes extremely difficult.

segments.fr: Se n'accorse bene quella volta il giudice D'Andrea,
segments.en: Judge D'Andrea found that out clearly that time,

segments.fr: appena alzò gli occhi a guardar il Chiàrchiaro,
segments.en: as soon as he raised his eyes to look at Chiàrchiaro,

segments.fr: che gli era entrato nella stanza,
segments.en: who had come into his room,

segments.fr: mentr'egli era intento a scrivere.
segments.en: while he was busy writing.

segments.fr: Ebbe uno scatto violentissimo e buttò all'aria le carte,
segments.en: He gave a violent start and sent his papers flying,

segments.fr: balzando in piedi e gridandogli:
segments.en: leaping to his feet and shouting at him:

segments.fr: «Ma fatemi il piacere! Che storie son queste? Vergognatevi!»
segments.en: "Oh, do me a favour! What nonsense is this? Shame on you!"
